viewing_check: Look at the signature on the Topps card in person: is it ink on the card surface (pen pressure, sheen, bleeds) or a flat printed or photocopied scrawl? Check for a COA or hologram on the back or backing board, and whether the card is the base card. Judge the frame and print quality.
